title: Prevent stale Multi-Site health summary double counting
implementation: Excluded stale healthy and no-data trends from current HealthySites and NoDataSites counts.
Excluded stale recovered history from RecoveredSites so stale data is represented only by StaleSites and its stale severity breakdown.
Added regression coverage proving current and stale summary counts do not overlap.

verification.tddRed: The new stale-count test initially reported HealthySites=2 instead of the expected current HealthySites=1.

boundary: Live PostgreSQL stale summary serialization, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, and visual responsive verification remain externally unverified.
Full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain outside this local run.
